services.description: Shelter and housing programs for youth and young adults experiencing homelessness, including 1440 Pine Housing and Nest56 Housing.

eligibilities.description: Youth and young adults experiencing homelessness

services.name: Youth drop-in and street outreach
services.description: Drop-in resource center, street outreach and housing navigation support for youth 25 and younger, open Monday-Friday 11 a.m.-5 p.m.

eligibilities.description: Youth 25 and younger

services.name: Child care referral line
services.description: Free quality rating and referral system that connects families with licensed child care and early learning programs across Colorado.

eligibilities.description: Families with young children

services.name: Farmers markets with SNAP and WIC
services.description: Seasonal farmers markets and a food hub, supporting more than 150 farmers and food businesses, with SNAP and WIC accepted at markets.

services.name: Free grocery programs
services.description: Redistributes nutritious food that might otherwise go to waste directly to community members in Longmont experiencing food, housing or financial insecurity, including through Fresh Food Connect.

eligibilities.description: Longmont community members facing food, housing or financial insecurity
